name: Christian Theosophy

phase_0.boundary_condition: Theosophical Society's doctrinal framework that contains and defines the system of esoteric knowledge

VINIT.justification: Represents the unmanifest source before differentiation, the void from which all spiritual emanation begins

TANCH.justification: Serves as the terminal boundary that closes the system, asserting the fundamental unity underlying all apparent diversity

AFWD.justification: Directed transformation ascending from material existence toward divine realization, the forward morphism of soul development

AREV.justification: Contravariant descent representing involution, the soul's contraction into denser states of being

CLINK.justification: Sequential chaining that links individual spiritual development to cosmic processes, composing personal and universal transformation

IMSCRIB.chosen_element: Self-aware monad recognizing its divine nature
IMSCRIB.justification: Identity element where the individual self recognizes itself as part of the universal self, the stone that knows itself

FSPLIT.chosen_element: Karma splitting into reward and punishment
FSPLIT.justification: One karmic action branches into two distinct paths: the positive consequence (reward) and negative consequence (punishment)

FFUSE.justification: The two karmic branches reconstitute the original karmic debt exactly through the law of cause and effect across lifetimes

EVALT.justification: Affirmative branch where the soul successfully progresses toward enlightenment and union with the divine

EVALF.justification: Negative branch where the soul remains trapped in material illusion and fails to achieve liberation

ENGAGR.chosen_element: Maya as simultaneous truth and illusion
ENGAGR.justification: Paradice where the phenomenal world is both real (as divine expression) and illusory (as temporary appearance), held without resolution

IFIX.chosen_element: Recorded spiritual attainment in akashic records
IFIX.justification: Permanent, append-only record of each soul's spiritual achievements that cannot be undone or altered

phase_2.split_element: Karma splitting into reward and punishment

phase_3.void_description: Unmanifest cosmic potential before the first divine emanation, the primordial silence preceding creation
phase_3.true_description: Successful spiritual realization where the monad achieves conscious union with the divine source
phase_3.false_description: Failed spiritual development where the soul remains bound to material existence and karmic cycles
phase_3.both_description: The paradoxical state of maya where phenomena are simultaneously real as divine expressions and illusory as temporary forms

steps.domain_action: Primordial cosmic egg (Golden Germ) represents the unmanifest void before creation
Theosophical axiom of universal brotherhood closes and contains the entire system
Spiritual evolution ascends through seven planes toward divine realization
Karma branches into reward and punishment as distinct causal paths
Spiritual advancement and liberation on the positive karmic path
Correspondence links individual development to cosmic processes
Karmic balance restores original cause through reincarnation law
Descent into material manifestation represents involutionary contraction
Karmic bondage and spiritual regression on the negative path
Maya holds both truth and illusion simultaneously without resolution
Self-aware monad recognizes its divine nature as identity element
Akashic records permanently fix each soul's spiritual attainment
Composition chains all transformations into coherent spiritual process
Universal brotherhood axiom reaffirms the closed boundary of the system

phase_5.compiler_frontend: Theosophical doctrine that translates spiritual intuitions into systematic metaphysical principles
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Correspondence and analogy through which spiritual laws communicate across different planes of existence
phase_5.memory_mechanism: Akashic records storing all karmic imprints and spiritual achievements of every soul
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: Karmic law determining the timing and sequence of spiritual experiences across lifetimes
phase_5.alfs_store: The Secret Doctrine by Helena Blavatsky as the canonical reference and bootstrap store for Theosophical knowledge

phase_6.cycle_cost: Spiritual effort and karmic expenditure required for each cycle of soul evolution
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: Soul bound in material illusion with accumulated karmic debt
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Soul liberated through divine knowledge with karmic balance restored
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The cycle is entropy-conservative because karmic law ensures exact compensation between cause and effect, maintaining cosmic equilibrium
